paragraphs: The Vito 110/111 CDI has been part of the Vito range since the late 1990s, and across its two generations has used three different engines — from the OM601 through to the OM646. The W638 generation (roughly 1996 to 2003) used the OM601 in various tune levels, while the W639 generation started with the OM611 (2003–2006) before switching to the OM646 in the facelift (2006–2014). The Vito 110/111 CDI is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every VITO 110 111 CDI on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the Vito 110/111 CDI spans three distinct engines across two generations, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an OM611 part will work on an OM646 van — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Vito quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
